segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You scramble to your feet to throw open the door, fully expecting a nightmare.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Instead, the entire canyon has gone completely silent.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Through the crack in the door, you see Titan standing in the middle of the snow. He still has the lead goblin clamped in his mouth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan’s big brown eyes were wide with pure, ecstatic realization.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A long, thick strand of drool hung from his jowl.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He opened his jaws, and the mangled wooden toy dropped onto the snow with a soft clack.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan took a deep, exploratory sniff of the splintered pine.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His little docked tail began to buzz. First a slow wag... then faster... until his entire muscular back half was violently vibrating with pure, unadulterated canine joy!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan looked through the door at you, his eyes shining:

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: WOOD?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan bellowed, his voice filled with glorious disbelief.

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: THEY'RE MADE OF WOOD?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The remaining thirty wooden goblins froze in complete bewilderment.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: THE BEAST HAS DISMANTLED SERGEANT PINE,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: a wooden goblin whispered, clicking its claws nervously.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: WHY IS IT WAGGLING ITS POSTERIOR?

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: I LOVE CRUNCHING ON WOOD!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan shouted, doing a giant, bouncy puppy-pounce in the snow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: WOOD IS MY ABSOLUTE FAVORITE THING IN THE ENTIRE MULTIVERSE! THIS IS BETTER THAN STICKS AT THE PARK! THIS IS LIKE A WHOLE FOREST OF FLAVORED STICKS!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan bounded forward with a happy snort!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CHOMP-CRUNCH-SNAP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He grabbed a second wooden goblin by its carved arm. The tough hardwood splintered like a dry potato chip between his giant molars!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CRACK-CRUNCH-MUNCH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: OH GINGER-SNAPS!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the goblins screamed, their wooden legs scrambling in reverse.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: RETREAT! RETREAT! THE DEMON-DOG IS EATING THE SQUADRON!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan was having the greatest day of his entire life. He was pouncing on wooden toys, tossing them twenty feet into the air, catching them, and happily grinding them into fine cedar mulch with loud, satisfying CRUNCHES!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He poked his big, grinning, black-freckled face through the doorway, his mouth full of splinters:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You guys go ahead and talk to Barnaby!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan puffed happily, his tail wagging a hundred miles an hour.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Take your time! Seriously, take all the time you need! I've got like forty more sticks to chew!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CHOMP-CRUNCH.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip stared at the bulldog in speechless, jaw-dropped awe.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Well,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip muttered, slowly straightening his tie.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: A completely planned canine diversion. I orchestrated the whole thing.
